resources.string: Not synced yet on this device
Your projects stay in your account and are removed from this device.
Your account and all synced projects are deleted from the server, and this device’s copy is removed. This can’t be undone.
Sync isn’t set up in this build. Your projects are saved on this device and work fully offline.
When you reconnect to the internet, Chronova asks before syncing your changes.
This version of Chronova isn’t connected to a server, so you can’t sign in. Install a version that is.
Sign in to use Chronova. Your projects are kept in your account and still work on this phone without a connection.
Sign in to sync your projects between devices. Without an account everything stays on this device.
Enter the code we emailed you.
A confirmation code is on its way to your email.
Already have an account? Sign in
Enter your email and we’ll send a code to set a new password.
Enter the code from the email and your new password. Other devices will be signed out.
If an account exists for this email, a reset code is on its way.
An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
Use upper- and lower-case letters and a number.
That code isn’t right or has expired. Check the email or send a new one.
This account has been disabled. Contact support.
That code has expired. Send a new one.
Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
Can’t reach the server. Check your connection.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
